profile.headline: Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary: I am a Software Engineer at Google and MIT graduate, originally from Louisville Kentucky.

positions.title: Student Researcher
positions.description: Working on developing and protoyping user interfaces for the Scratch Programming editor (scratch.mit.edu), with focus on tablet devices.

positions.title: Technical Intern
positions.description:
- Integrated new videoplayer metrics to track quality of service across the player, using Javascript/YUI.
- Using Splunk IT tools, created reports and dashboards displaying analytics for tracking player performance.

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description:
-Developed front-end features using Javascript, HTML/CSS, to streamline user interface of browser extension product.
-Created and updated reporting tools to allow for international statistics, monitoring of support services, and analyzing of consumer reach for marketing purposes.
-Programmed and incorporated build-and-sign processes for Firefox and Safari into a continuous integration server.
-Wrote and incorporated software tests to ensure quality into a continuous integration server.

positions.title: Front End Developer
positions.description: Designed and implemented using JQuery Mobile, HTML, and CSS a cleaner user interface for an online biology-themed video game targeting high school students, as one of three developers on the project.

company.name: MIT Scheller Teacher Education Program Lab

positions.title: Computer Science Intern
positions.description:
- Designed and implemented a developer tool that used file I/O and regular expressions to find new compiler warnings in code after each daily build of software.
- Integrated tool into Visual Studio as an add-in that checked for new compiler warnings after every local build, allowing up-to-date warning tracking at the developer level.

positions.title: Volunteer Researcher
positions.description: Responsibilities include installing, testing, and publicizing the "Lightbridge" project, which aims to don the Harvard Bridge with colorful programmable LED's to recognize MIT"s 150th anniversary.

projects.title: LazyTruth
projects.description: We built a Gmail extension that gives you one-click access to verified information when you receive forwarded emails.

organizations.name: Phi Delta Theta Fraternity, Massachusetts Gamma Chapter
organizations.position: Community Service Chair, Historian, Pledge Educator · Jan 2012 - Present
organizations.description: Phi Delta Theta is a fraternity committed to fostering the three Cardinal Principles of Friendship, Sound Learning, and Moral Rectitude through brotherhood, personal growth, and community service.

organizations.name: Camp Kesem MIT
organizations.position: Student Support Coordinator, Camper Care Coordinator · Mar 2011 - Sep 2013
organizations.description:
Camp Kesem MIT is a student-run organization that holds a week-long summer camp for the children of parents who have/had cancer. It is a chapter of the national Camp Kesem organization.

- Current responsibilities as Student Support Coordinator include informing potential student counselors, processing applications, managing the counselor interview and selection process, planning and running counselor training sessions, in order to support the education and well-being of students involved with the Camp Kesem organization.
-As one of two Camper Care Coordinators, recruited potential campers, communicated with their families, and accommodated their medical needs through the acquisition of professional staff in order to fully support their experience at camp.
